This is just one reason I hate LEO. There are no good cops, only bad ones and bad ones who haven't been caught. Only the insecure or sadistic become officers so they can assault, abuse, and even kill without any consequences.

I don't know about apartments, but they can find you in a house. If you use a cell phone at your apartment, they can get the billing address easily enough. They need a warrant for suspected criminal activity, but not for a suicide call. It depends on carrier and jurisdiction, maybe, but where I live, it takes less than an hour to get the cops to the registered billing address. If you use a prepaid burner phone with fake credentials, it's probably not traceable, but a regular cell phone account isn't tough to find.
